node.opening: Something has been moving around the back lots today, {playerFirstName}.
node.details: The trail circles close, disappears, then turns up where it shouldn't.
node.personal: I kept thinking about where you were every time I heard it.
node.followup: I feel better with you in the conversation, even if the problem is still there.
node.closing: Let's make sure both of us are here to compare notes tomorrow.
choice.press: Show me the trail. I can read it.
choice.reassure: I'm here, and you're not facing this alone.
choice.challenge: We cannot let fear control us.
choice.advice: What do you want us to do?
choice.wrap_up: Let's leave it there for now.
response.detail.open: It came near enough that I could hear the fence move, then everything went quiet.
response.detail.guarded: I don't know enough yet, and I hate admitting that.
response.personal.open: Of course I was. Losing track of you is worse than the noise.
response.personal.guarded: Maybe. Don't make me say more than that right now.
response.offer_help.open: Together, yes. I don't want either of us checking it alone.
response.offer_help.guarded: Only if we turn back the moment it feels wrong.
response.press.open: The crushed grass points east, but one set of prints returns toward us.
response.press.guarded: Read it, but don't pretend the ground tells the whole story.
response.reassure.open: I know. Hearing you say it still matters.
response.challenge.open: You're right. Careful together, not frightened apart.
response.challenge.guarded: I'm allowed to be afraid when your life is involved.
response.advice.open: Stay together, check the eastern fence, and be home before dark.
response.advice.guarded: Wait until morning. I trust daylight more than guesses.
response.wrap_up.open: All right. Just don't forget what I told you.
response.promise.open: That promise means more coming from you.
response.promise.guarded: I'll believe it when you come back safely.
locked.personal: They are not ready to be that vulnerable with you.
locked.skill: You need more Foraging experience to interpret the trail.
locked.personality: Their personality makes that challenge too risky.
locked.promise: Their current approval is too low for that promise to land.
